positionNote: The packet splits 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' into two array entries; positions below treat it as one ingredient (#1), so each cited position is the array index minus one from entry 3 onward.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: exact C1 pattern - early Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3, refatting PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate #5, no second reinforcing anionic or reset route, no reset intent ('reinigt sanft').
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: SLES is a strong-cleansing clue in isolation.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: multiple complementary systems per C2 - early Dimethicone #8, Amodimethicone #12, cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #13, pearlizing/waxy Glycol Distearate #16 and Hydrogenated Castor Oil #15, humectant Panthenol #7, refatting PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate #5, Hydrolyzed Keratin #6, Apricot Kernel Oil #21. C2 says cleansing does not lower this.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W1 pattern - silicone (Dimethicone #8) plus cationic guar #13 plus later Amodimethicone #12 in an effective SLES/betaine base and not a rich 2-in-1 -> moderate, not high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone/guar/amodimethicone deposition is persistent but bounded by a C1 cleansing base (W1).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: High needs multiple converging persistent systems with limited reset or a rich 2-in-1; extra hydrogenated castor oil #15, glycol distearate #16 and apricot oil #21 converge further, so high is the realistic neighbor.
weightPotential.counterSignal: More converging routes than the W1 reference (waxy HCO, pearlizer, keratin, apricot oil).

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: dominant exact-product claim is the '3% Panthenol-Feuchtigkeits-Komplex' and 'Spendet langanhaltende Feuchtigkeit'/'Nährt'; formula verdict dual_supported (humectant/refatting cluster Panthenol #7 + PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate #5 + Propylene Glycol with emollient deposition; and a substantive deposition/damage-care cluster keratin #6 + amodimethicone #12 + dimethicone #8). Claims break the tie toward moisture (F1). Curl definition is a hair_texture outcome, not a focus.

careDirection.limitation: Humectant cluster is thin (no glycerin); '3%' is a claim, not proven concentration.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: 'stärkt das Haar von innen' and keratin/amodimethicone point to repair.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: rich silicone/guar/keratin deposition + panthenol -> dual_supported. Unblind: name/claims center on moisture complex -> tie broken to moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'stärkt von innen' and curl definition are outcomes of the same deposition route used by the primary (F2); no distinct secondary positioning with its own route.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no explicit daily/frequent positioning; 'reinigt sanft' is mildness wording, not a frequent-use instruction; not strong (§9 default).
usageRole.counterSignal: 'Reinigt sanft' could be read as 'mild-use positioning' -> frequent.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: no sensitive/itchy/dry-scalp positioning ('reinigt sanft die Kopfhaut' is mildness); ordinary fragranced formula.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole (Sodium Salicylate is a preservative).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C high: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse ideal. Ordinary target, no T6. T4: W neighbor high would make fine not_suited (ordinary, acceptable->not_suited) -> flag fine; would make normal acceptable -> flag normal; coarse stays ideal at W high and C has no neighbor -> no flag. T2: curl/Locken claims ignored for fit.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular. I3: no neighbor.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: No D1 term ('Tiefenpflegende'/'Tiefenspülung' are care, not cleansing terms).
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Packet INCI artifact: 'Aqua (Water' / 'Eau)' split into two entries; treated as one ingredient. Does not affect any value.
§9 'mild-use positioning' is undefined: whether 'reinigt sanft' counts as frequent trigger. Resolved to regular (default) since no daily/frequent wording.

W1 fixes silicone+guar+late amodimethicone at moderate but does not say how many extra converging routes (HCO, glycol distearate, oil) move it to high; resolved moderate with high as neighbor, which triggers two T4 flags.
Coarse T7 parity: coarse x C high x W moderate is ideal in T1 but would display amber live (T7 known divergence).
